description.en: The certificate ID followed by "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is \`123\`, the value of CertIdentifier is \`123-cn-hangzhou\`.

description.zh:
指定国密证书所属的加速域名。

>加速域名需属于HTTPS加速类型。
description.en:
The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the SM certificate.

> The domain name must use HTTPS acceleration.

description.zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

- **on**：启用。
- **off**：不启用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the SM certificate.

- **on**: enable.
- **off**: disable.

descriptions.en: > The call frequency is limited to 30 calls per second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn set-dcdn-domain-sm-certificate --domain-name example.com --cert-identifier 123-cn-hangzhou --ssl-protocol on --region cn-hangzhou
